# GitHub issue template

Used to turn a GitHub milestone's targets into one or more issues in that milestone. Issues start as rough outlines and are refined before implementation. Sub-issues are only created while planning the implementation of a single issue.

**Title:** states the intent clearly, e.g. `Setup agent skills directory` or `Add password reset workflow`.

**Description:**

```md
# Description

[maximum 2 sentences description]

# Scope

## In scope

- [brief bullet points of what is in scope for this issue]

## Out of scope

- [brief bullet points of what is out of scope for this issue]

# Acceptance Criteria

- [clear, domain-level, human-readable criteria; no technical details or file references unless they are part of the domain; concise]

# Technical Details

- [technical details, file references, implementation hints and other context, mainly for agents]
```
